name: CLEVRER: Collision Events for Video Representation and Reasoning
description: CLEVRER is a diagnostic video reasoning benchmark containing 20,000 synthetic videos of colliding geometric objects and 304,917 questions evaluating descriptive, explanatory, predictive, and counterfactual causal reasoning.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.notes: CLEVRER videos and annotations are released under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.

source_references.title: CLEVRER: CoLlision Events for Video REpresentation and Reasoning

verification.notes: Verified against ICLR 2020 paper (arXiv: 1910.01442) and MIT CSAIL repository. Exactly 20,000 synthetic videos (train: 10,000, validation: 5,000, test: 5,000) with 304,917 questions across descriptive, explanatory, predictive, and counterfactual reasoning types.

size.notes: MP4 synthetic videos and JSON question annotations.
